name: WhatsApp click-to-chat links (wa.me, manual pivot links)
tier_rationale: Established company running a major messaging platform with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted); P128 cond 5 'wa.me and t.me trusted'.

reliability.justification: Generic click-to-chat page for any number: it carries no information about the number and is never read by V3LUM (manual links only).

chat_links.title: wa.me/{digits} click-to-chat deep links (manual pivot links, off by default)
chat_links.notes: Quote: research C0798 terms (verified_live: wa.me/15555550100 answered 302 to api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=..., the same generic page for any number). Off by default (setting phone_messaging_links=false), privacy=true, analyst-typed phone seeds of an opted-in case only, with the notice 'manual: opens the app with YOUR account; nothing is sent unless you type; use a team research device'; never fetched and never a presence check (P128 cond 2 and 4, P131 rejected). Opening the link hands the number to WhatsApp/Meta (redirect to api.whatsapp.com), whose privacy policy lets it use such data to operate and improve its services: reuses_queries=true (conservative). Used by pivots_phone.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G06-1 (P128). Manual pivot links only: V3LUM never requests wa.me or api.whatsapp.com.
